newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish unions to meet gvt on metals privatisation.
newsitem.headline: Spanish unions to meet gvt on metals privatisation.

text.p: Spain's Workers Commission Union (CCOO) and General Workers Union (UGT) said on Tuesday they will meet Industry Minister Josep Pique at 1700 GMT to discuss the privatisation of aluminium producer Inespal and steel firm Corporacion Siderurgica Integral (CSI).
"We hope to continue cooperating with the government, also on Inespal and CSI," a union official told journalists following the signing of a restructuring plan for the mining business.

"This is the first meeting after the strike. We really hope to reach the same positive results," a UGT spokesman told Reuters. "Apart from Inespal and CSI we hope to discuss also more in general the government's industrial plans for state firms."
On July 4, unions called a 24-hour strike to protest against the privatisation of Inespal, followed by another one-day strike by all metal workers on July 11.
Spanish State holding company SEPI is in talks with the U.S. Aluminium Company of America (Alcoa) to sell Inespal.
Another state holding company, Agencia Industrial del Estado (AIE), is in talks on the sale of CSI.
